exactAnchor.quote: NENU Bachelor’s Programs for International Students 2027

eligibility: In good physical and mental health, with excellent academic performance and conduct, and in compliance with Chinese laws, regulations, and university rules.
Applicants for bachelor’s degree programs must be between 18 and 25 years old and hold a high school diploma or an equivalent academic qualification.

Former Chinese citizens who have acquired foreign nationality and apply to our University as international students must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or longer (inclusive), and must have actually resided abroad for at least two years within the most recent four years (as of April 30, 2027).

Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, and who acquired foreign nationality at birth, must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or longer (inclusive), and must have actually resided abroad for at least two years within the most recent four years (as of April 30, 2027).
All applicants for bachelor’s degree programs must take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) organized by the China Scholarship Council (CSC).

For majors and tuition, please refer to the NENU Bachelor’s Programs for International Students 2027(click to view).

Fill in the required information in Chinese or English, upload all materials, and pay the application fee of RMB 400 online.
Applicants from Malaysian Independent Chinese Secondary Schools are not required to submit proof of Chinese proficiency.

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizens.
In good physical and mental health, with excellent academic performance and conduct, and in compliance with Chinese laws, regulations, and university rules.
Applicants for bachelor’s degree programs must be between 18 and 25 years old and hold a high school diploma or an equivalent academic qualification.

Former Chinese citizens who have acquired foreign nationality and apply to our University as international students must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or longer (inclusive), and must have actually resided abroad for at least two years within the most recent four years (as of April 30, 2027).

Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, and who acquired foreign nationality at birth, must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or longer (inclusive), and must have actually resided abroad for at least two years within the most recent four years (as of April 30, 2027).
All applicants for bachelor’s degree programs must take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) organized by the China Scholarship Council (CSC).
Required CSCA subjects: Humanities Chinese, Mathematics.

notes.en: Intake season and calendar opening date are not explicitly stated; no autumn or opening date is inferred. HSK numeric minimum score is not specified. Malaysian Independent Chinese Secondary School language-certificate waiver is conditional and does not waive CSCA.
